parameters.query:
SELECT mt.id,
       mt.cash_session_id,
       cs.status AS session_status,
       cm.id     AS cash_movement_id
FROM public.miscellaneous_transactions mt
LEFT JOIN public.cash_sessions  cs ON cs.id = mt.cash_session_id
LEFT JOIN public.cash_movements cm ON cm.source_id = mt.id
                                  AND cm.source_type = 'miscellaneous'
WHERE mt.id = $1;

WITH upd AS (
    UPDATE public.miscellaneous_transactions
    SET category_id       = $2::int,
        beneficiary       = $3,
        amount            = $4::numeric,
        currency          = COALESCE(NULLIF($5::text, ''), currency),
        exchange_rate     = COALESCE($6::numeric, 1),
        payment_method_id = COALESCE($7::int, payment_method_id),
        transaction_date  = COALESCE(NULLIF($8::text, '')::date, transaction_date),
        description       = $9,
        reference_number  = NULLIF($10::text, ''),
        tags              = CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof($11::jsonb) = 'array'
                                 THEN ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($11::jsonb))
                                 ELSE tags END,
        updated_by        = $12::uuid,
        updated_at        = NOW()
    WHERE id = $1
    RETURNING *
),
mov AS (
    UPDATE public.cash_movements cm
    SET type              = CASE WHEN mc.category_type = 'income' THEN 'income' ELSE 'expense' END,
        payment_method_id = COALESCE(upd.payment_method_id, cm.payment_method_id),
        amount            = ABS(COALESCE(upd.converted_amount, upd.amount))
                            * CASE WHEN mc.category_type = 'income' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END,
        description       = (CASE WHEN COALESCE(upd.converted_amount, upd.amount) < 0 THEN '[DEVOLUCIÓN] ' ELSE '' END)
                            || upd.description
                            || CASE WHEN upd.reference_number IS NOT NULL
                                    THEN ' (Ref: ' || upd.reference_number || ')'
                                    ELSE '' END,
        currency          = upd.currency,
        is_sales          = (mc.category_type = 'income'),
        updated_by        = upd.updated_by
    FROM upd
    JOIN public.miscellaneous_categories mc ON mc.id = upd.category_id
    WHERE cm.source_type = 'miscellaneous'
      AND cm.source_id = upd.id
    RETURNING cm.id
)
SELECT upd.*, (SELECT id FROM mov LIMIT 1) AS cash_movement_id
FROM upd;

SELECT mt.id,
       mt.cash_session_id,
       cs.status AS session_status,
       cm.id     AS cash_movement_id
FROM public.miscellaneous_transactions mt
LEFT JOIN public.cash_sessions  cs ON cs.id = mt.cash_session_id
LEFT JOIN public.cash_movements cm ON cm.source_id = mt.id
                                  AND cm.source_type = 'miscellaneous'
WHERE mt.id = $1;

WITH del_mov AS (
    DELETE FROM public.cash_movements
    WHERE source_type = 'miscellaneous' AND source_id = $1
    RETURNING id
)
DELETE FROM public.miscellaneous_transactions
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id;

SELECT
  a.id,
  a.code,
  a.name,
  a.description,
  a.category_type,
  a.is_active,
  a.account_code,
  a.parent_id,
  a.created_at,
  a.updated_at,
  COUNT(*) OVER() AS total
FROM
  miscellaneous_categories a
WHERE
  (COALESCE($1, '') = '' OR
    (
      a.name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.description ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.category_type ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.account_code ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.created_at::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.updated_at::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
    )
  )
  AND (COALESCE($4, '') = '' OR a.category_type = $4)
ORDER BY
  a.created_at DESC
LIMIT $2
OFFSET $3;
